label: calibration
design: Cohorts of 60 ticks; each successor cohort arrives 30 ticks before its seniors retire, identically in every condition (same physical population, resources and action time). Repaired beam search. 'teaching-only' uses the declared package-scheduled mentorship: juniors re-request lessons from earlier-cohort neighbours at a bounded interval, teachers skip workflows already offered to that learner and never start a lesson that cannot finish before their scheduled retirement; dependencies are taught inside the lesson at separately charged work. Retirement is never delayed.
